maddeler.e:
ننعتق (form VII)
# نَنْعَتِقُ (nanʕatiqu) /nan.ʕa.ti.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْعَتَقَ (inʕataqa)
# نَنْعَتِقَ (nanʕatiqa) /nan.ʕa.ti.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَتَقَ (inʕataqa)
# نَنْعَتِقْ (nanʕatiq) /nan.ʕa.tiq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْعَتَقَ (inʕataqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
